Subscription details and cancellation

Your ledger, on your device.

Start in Local, or explore Demo. No sign-in is needed for either workspace.

Local and Demo stay separate. Signing in with Google connects subscription access; it does not automatically upload these records.

Cloud sharing is paused. Invitations, remote receipt transfers and automatic cloud-account deletion are also paused. Previously saved Cloud ledgers remain viewable and exportable, with pending changes preserved.

Bounty records what you enter. It does not move money or link to your bank. Keep backups and original receipt files where you can recover them.

Read how Bounty handles data

Before you start.

A few useful answers about accounts, sharing and subscriptions.

Do I need an account?

You can use Local and Demo without signing in. Google sign-in connects your account for subscription access. It does not automatically upload either workspace.

Can friends sync a group together?

Cloud sharing, invitations and remote receipt transfers are paused. You can keep shared-expense records on your device and export them. Previously saved Cloud ledgers remain viewable and exportable, with pending changes preserved.

Does recording a settlement send money?

No. Bounty records expenses, balances and settlements you enter. Arrange the actual payment separately, then record it in the app.

What happens when Pro ends?

Core tools stay free, and existing records and recurring rules remain accessible. Creating or changing recurring rules, advanced insights and supported receipt text scanning require Pro.

How do I manage or cancel Pro?

Manage the subscription through Google Play. Uninstalling Bounty, signing out or deleting your Bounty account does not cancel renewal. Read subscription information.

How can I get help or request account deletion?

Use Your corner → Request account deletion in the app, or follow the website’s support and account-deletion instructions. Requests are handled manually after ownership verification. Opening an email link does not submit a request or confirm deletion. Account and data deletion.
